test_cases.description: Verify ChemistryDomainAdapter implements standard domain adapter contract (tool adapter, evaluators, curriculum adapter, entity normalizer, misconceptions catalog).
Verify tool and evaluator registries initialize cleanly without errors when Chemistry is disabled.
Verify ToolRegistry omits chemistry tools when disabled even under an all-enabled policy.
Verify ToolExecutionEngine rejects chemistry tools with ToolNotFoundError when disabled.
Verify EvaluatorRegistry falls back to RubricEvaluator for chemical items without crashing when chemistry evaluator is unregistered.
Verify equation_balancer and formula_parser execute accurately when enabled.
Verify ChemistryEquationEvaluator accurately evaluates balanced chemical equations with correct and incorrect scores.
Verify Math and Programming tools/evaluators function with 100% fidelity when Chemistry is disabled.
Verify non-Chemistry courses return False for can_handle_course and cannot accidentally load or trigger chemistry logic.
Verify generic queries do not trigger Chemistry concept keyword matcher when disabled.
Verify dynamic toggle updates ToolRegistry capabilities immediately without restart.
Verify GAYATRI_ENABLE_CHEMISTRY_ADAPTER=0 disables adapter during instantiation.
